howItWorks.heroDescription: Pambala connects buyers and sellers across Angola. See how easy it is to buy and sell on our platform.
howItWorks.stepsSubtitle: Shopping on Pambala is easy and secure
howItWorks.step1Description: Browse categories, search for specific products, or explore partner stores. Find thousands of products from verified sellers nationwide.
howItWorks.step2Description: Choose Multicaixa Express, bank transfer, or cash on delivery. Our system ensures payment is only released once you confirm receipt.
howItWorks.step3Description: Your product is shipped directly from the seller to your door. Track your order status in real time. Delivery to all provinces of Angola.
howItWorks.benefit1Description: If the product doesn't arrive or doesn't match the description, we'll refund your money.
howItWorks.benefit2Description: Delivery in 24-72 hours in Luanda and 3-7 days for other provinces.
howItWorks.benefit3Description: Our team is available to help whenever you need it.
howItWorks.benefit4Description: All sellers go through a rigorous verification process.
howItWorks.faq1Question: How do I sign up for Pambala?
howItWorks.faq1Answer: Click "Sign up" in the top-right corner. Fill in your details and choose whether you want to be a buyer or seller. It's free!
howItWorks.faq2Question: How do I sell my products?
howItWorks.faq2Answer: Register as a seller, set up your store, and start listing your products. It's simple and fast.
howItWorks.faq3Answer: Yes! We use an escrow system. Payment is only released to the seller when you confirm receipt of the product.
howItWorks.faq4Answer: In Luanda: 24-72 hours. Other provinces: 3-7 business days. Timeframes may vary depending on the seller and location.
howItWorks.faq5Answer: Yes, you have 7 days to return the product if you're not satisfied. Refunds are processed within 48 hours.
howItWorks.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of Angolans already buying and selling on Pambala.
